content-final-supervisor v1.0.0

- Initial release with unified final content check entry (CP-01).
- Integrates with quality-supervisor-mcp to support script, storyboard, and video quality supervision.
- Supports redline checks, cross-stage consistency checks, automated redo, and final arbitration.
- Standardizes workflow for multi-stage content review, including automatic error and exception handling.
- Provides clear input/output specification and unified reporting structure.
